justification: A shows a large frontal anthropomorphic figure with a headdress and shallow, sparse geometric/emblematic motifs (a disc, bands, abstract signs) spread over a rounded body, while B shows a naturalistic profile ram's head with a densely rendered spiral horn and finely combed fleece; the only overlap is the very generic presence of shallow carved curvilinear forms and a roughly circular element (A's disc vs B's coiled horn). The subject matter (human-like standing figure vs horned animal), the density and naturalism of detail, and the compositional logic are entirely different.
